problem_statement: The Border Routing Manager does not handle Recursive DNS Server (RDNSS) options received in Router Advertisements from infrastructure-link routers. Routers that advertise RDNSS options should have their advertised DNS server addresses discovered and tracked (with lifetime, age and the advertising router), and the set of discovered RDNSS addresses should be iterable and should fire a change callback when addresses are added, removed, age out, or the advertising router becomes unreachable. RA messages emitted by the border router are also expected to be able to carry RDNSS options. Add the behavior so RDNSS addresses are discovered from RAs, exposed for iteration, and a change callback can be registered.
